name: Deactivating Touch (Item Mastery)
body:
You can deactivate magic items with a touch.

Prerequisite(s): Magic item skill class feature, Use Magic Device 10 ranks.

Benefit(s): As a standard action, you can deactivate an activated magic item with a touch. If the item is currently in possession of a creature, you must succeed with a touch attack to deactivate it. The item remains deactivated for 1d4 rounds or until it is activated again. This feat does not work on artifacts.
